correctness.rationale: All directed cycles in the reversed tournament are triangles j->i->k->j for i<k<j. A failed singleton valuation must induce one; three roles give the 1+2(j-i-1) failures for j<n, while terminal j=n has only one or zero. Adjacent reversals remain transitive, and terminal skip-one produces a dominated terminal triangle of outdegree one; both validate the axiom for every valuation. The extracted standalone checker enumerated all 119 flipped frames through order nine and all 11,256 small-frame truth assignments through eight. Finite tests are not the all-order proof.

value.rationale: Positive introspection is classically guaranteed on transitive tournaments; the theorem gives the sharp robustness boundary under every possible one-arc perturbation, identifies the unique nontransitive safe reversal, and measures the exact number of singleton-world counterobservations at each position. The global n-parameter spectrum is structurally motivated and not merely a small-case table.
